description: Form label tied to a control by the htmlFor attribute.

howToUse: Use it to name a field when you build your own control and it does not have a `label` prop.
Point `htmlFor` to the `id` of the field: clicking the label focuses the field, and screen readers read the name.
alternatives: Input, Select and the other fields already have `label`: use it.
A label with an explanation: HelpField.

keyboard.action: The label does not receive focus. Clicking it focuses the field.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
